facility.name: Little Bloomers
facility.programs_provided: After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 1017 S F ST, HARLINGEN, TX, 78550

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Out of all staff files reviewed, all staff were missing the following trainngs:  emergenccy preparedeness, preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, administering medication, preventing and responding to emergencies, understanding building and premises safety, handling, storing and disposing of medication.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment: Staff files reviewed shows that they are missing training in child maltreatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points: There is a Lil Tykes type of structure that has a cracked in the middle section which poses a pinching hazards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points (26 TAC §746.4601(7))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: There are 2 caregivers who rotate being caring for infants who do not have current training in SIDS.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Out of children's files reviewed, 1 was missing the needed immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: There were a total of 10 toddlers with 1 caregivver.  The specified age was 22 months which  caused the classroom to be out of ratio by 1.   (NOTE:  Corrected during inspection as the oldest child was moved into the next classroom.)
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: There is an old indoor AC blower in the corner of the playground accessible to the children.  There was an old flower pot that was rusted at the bottom and had fallen over (this was removed from the playground.)
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2024 data from January 16, 2025, revealed the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2024 by January 15, 2025, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age: There was a napping mat in the afterschool room that had tears on top.  It does not allow for proper sanitizing.  (NOTE:  corrected during inspection by throwing it away)
occurrences.violation_type_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §746.4503(a))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Employees Know Who Is in Charge: Based on the DFPS investigation it was determined that the none of the staff understood who was in charge of the center while the director was out of the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Employees Know Who Is in Charge (26 TAC §746.1013(c))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Based on the information gained during the investigation, the caregiver's actions do rise to the level of abuse as defined by the Texas Family Code since the child was observed with marks and bruises due to inappropriate restraint.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: During the course of the DFPS investigation, it was determined that the infant caregiver was in charge of infants and afterschool children with one of the youngest school age children being at least 6 years old with the infants at least 17 months of age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: During a DFPS investigation, it was found that a child was hit on the head by a caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: During a DFPS investigation is was found that the children in the 3 year old classroom were being yelled at.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised: During a DFPS investigation, it was found that infants had been left unsupervised while caregiver was outside with a group of school-age children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list: The employee list was validated while inspector was present. (NOTE: Corrected during inspection.)
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list (26 TAC §745.651(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list: The background checks had not been validated since May 23,2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list (26 TAC §745.651(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: There were 2 areas on the playground fence that needs to have boards replaced.   (Pictures on file)
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: This deficiency is not related to investigation:  Observed seven infants waiting for lunch to be served while television was on.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Admission information was not available for a child that is enrolled and attending day care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: Observed two caregivers present and in charge of a group of children in the operation without having had a background check /FBI.  Observed a third employee present in the building without having a background check/FBI.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: This deficiency is not related to investigation:  Facility does not have a current Fire Inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Immunizations were not available for a child that is enrolled and attends day care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Operation Open to Parents At All Times: Observed that facility does not allow parents to have access inside the building to drop off children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Operation Open to Parents At All Times (26 TAC §746.201(7))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: Permit holder needs to ensure that facility complies with child/caregiver ratios and must allow parents access inside facility to drop off and pick up their children during business hours as well as comply with Minimum Standards and all applicable Laws and Rules.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Observed a caregiver supervising 6  infants.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: Observed chlidren having breakfast and did not wash their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Observed a caregiver supervising 9 infants. Child/caregiver ratios for infants 12 months to 17 months is 5:1.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking Water Available and Served: Observed that water was not served during breakfast.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking Water Available and Served (26 TAC §746.3301(f))

occurrences.finding: Operation Open to Parents At All Times: Observed that facility does not allow parents to have access inside the building to drop off children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Operation Open to Parents At All Times (26 TAC §746.201(7))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children: A caregiver was heard using an inappropriate tone with children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children (26 TAC §746.1201(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: A caregiver's files was not available at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Child Care Center Employees and Caregivers - TB Exam: Two caregivers do not have TB results available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Child Care Center Employees and Caregivers - TB Exam (26 TAC §746.1105(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Two children files are missing immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: A caregiver does not have annual training hours for cycle 11/26/20 to 11/25/21. A second caregiver does not have annual training hours for cycle 9/12/20 to 9/11/21.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: A caregiver does not have first aid training available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Facility does not have a current fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: A caregiver does not have CPR training available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: Director does not have annual training for cycle 8/24/20 to 8/23/21.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information obtained during investigation it was determined that a caregiver grabbed a child inappropriately.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
